description: GCPRO monthly Gas & Tolls, Dumpster and Inventory accounting reports using the existing verified accounting utilities.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me generate a GCPRO gas, dumpster or inventory accounting report from my supplied inputs.
interface.longDescription: One GCPRO Accounting Skill for Gas & Tolls, Dumpster and Inventory. Preserves the existing GAS engine and nine-sheet workbook; shares its parsers, job normalization and exact-cent allocation utilities. Construction Dumpster uses Construction jobs started in the report month, weighted by Total Estimates. Inventory uses one common eligible-hours pool. Requires a file-execution environment with Node.js 20+.

name: gcpro-gas-report
